events.what: Montgomery & Sauermann prove (1-o(1))n disjoint transversal bases can be packed and (1+o(1))n suffice to cover, improving (1/2-o(1))n
Arndt, Moseley, Pruhs, Swamy & Zlatin give a polynomial-time algorithm achieving an asymptotic version of the packing result for arbitrary matroids
Sauermann: Rota's basis conjecture holds for random bases of vector spaces
Latin Tableau Conjecture, a generalisation of Rota's basis conjecture in the free-matroid case, with computational checks of small cases

judgement.doubts: Arndt et al. makes an existing bound constructive rather than moving it, so it is coded none. Its date 2604 as arXiv ID places it April 2026. The Chow-Tiefenbruck arXiv ID 2408 implies August 2024, but the record gives only the year. Either way it is a variant, and the pre-snapshot Sauermann case does not make the status open_stale.
